summary: Iteration 19 — Cloned-voice TTS (/desktop/speak + /desktop/voice/status) and PyInstaller .exe build pipeline. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_voice_speak.py with 11 tests, ALL PASS (1 live ElevenLabs MP3 round-trip + 10 negatives/structure). Verified: GET /desktop/voice/status returns {configured:false, voice_id:'', voice_name:''} for a user without elevenlabs_voice_id; returns {configured:true, voice_id:'vid_test_xyz', voice_name:'My Clone'} when user has both elevenlabs_api_key + elevenlabs_voice_id; returns 401 with no Authorization header; env-only branch (env ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set, user has voice_id but no user-key) also returns configured:true (env fallback works). POST /desktop/speak returns 401 with no auth, 400 with detail 'Voice clone not configured — open the web Settings…' when user has no voice_id, 422 on empty text (pydantic min_length=1), 422 on text > 4000 chars (pydantic max_length=4000). LIVE smoke: fetched first voice_id from ElevenLabs /v1/voices using the .env key, mounted it on the test user, POST {text:'this is a test'} returned 200 with Content-Type 'audio/mpeg', body > 1024 bytes, and X-Voice-Id header matching the configured voice. Zip pipeline: build_desktop_app_zip_bytes('comp_iter19_test') now contains 'heirloom.spec' AND 'Build-Heirloom-Exe.bat' at the zip root (the builder uses pkg_root.rglob('*') so they were picked up automatically — no companion.py code change needed). heirloom.spec is syntactically valid Python (ast.parse passes). Regressions: iter18 9/9 PASS, iter17 12/12 PASS (after expanding EXPECTED_FILES by +2 — the test's hardcoded zip-contents set didn't include the two new .exe pipeline files; the zip builder is correct), iter16 8/8 PASS, user_isolation_fuzz 10/10 PASS. Total: 50/50.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/desktop.py:desktop_speak — Clean fail-fast on missing voice_id/key (HTTP 400) so the desktop app can fall back to silent waveform pulse without retrying. Uses httpx.AsyncClient with 60s timeout (reasonable for ElevenLabs TTS). Maps 401-from-ElevenLabs → 400 ('key invalid or revoked') and 404 → 400 ('voice id not found') so the desktop UI never has to handle 5xx for user-configurable problems — only 502 for true upstream blow-ups. Returns audio/mpeg bytes directly (no base64) with X-Voice-Id header — correct for QMediaPlayer playback.

routers/desktop.py:desktop_voice_status — Note that `configured` is true when (user.elevenlabs_api_key OR module-level ELEVENLABS_API_KEY) AND user.elevenlabs_voice_id are present. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is read at MODULE IMPORT TIME (`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY = os.environ.get(...)` at line 33), so the env-only branch was tested via the running server which had the key loaded at startup. The complementary case 'env unset + user voice_id only → configured=false' would require restarting the server with the env var cleared; not feasible from the test side. Covered by inspection.
MINOR: routers/desktop.py:desktop_speak strips text to 4000 chars (`text = payload.text.strip()[:4000]`) AFTER pydantic already enforces max_length=4000 — defensive but redundant. Harmless.

MINOR: routers/desktop.py:desktop_speak builds the `language_code` body field only when lang_pref ∉ {'', 'auto'} and len ≤ 8. Sensible bound, but no allowlist of ISO-639 codes — ElevenLabs will surface a 4xx if a bogus code is sent. Acceptable for v1.

routers/companion.py:build_desktop_app_zip_bytes — `pkg_root.rglob('*')` is the right call; it picked up the two new .exe-pipeline files at the project root automatically. NOTE: this also means ANY file dropped into /app/companion_desktop/ (including notes, .DS_Store, editor backups) will leak into the user-facing zip. Currently filtered: __pycache__. Consider also filtering hidden files (`.*`) and common editor cruft (`*.pyc`, `*~`, `.DS_Store`) before going to GA.

/app/companion_desktop/heirloom.spec — Valid Python (ast.parse passes). Excludes Qt6WebEngine/Charts/Quick3D and applies UPX with a safe exclusion list for Qt6Core/Network/Multimedia DLLs — matches the spec the request described. Cannot be END-to-END verified in this Linux container (PyInstaller needs Windows for the target .exe), but the static structure is sound.

/app/companion_desktop/Build-Heirloom-Exe.bat — Static review only (Windows batch). Creates a venv, installs requirements + pyinstaller, then `pyinstaller heirloom.spec`. Cannot be executed here; main agent should validate on a real Windows box.

TEST REGRESSION I FIXED: tests/test_iteration17_desktop.py TestBuildDesktopZip.EXPECTED_FILES did not include the two new iter19 .exe-pipeline files at the zip root. Expanded the set by +2 (heirloom.spec, Build-Heirloom-Exe.bat). The zip builder is correct; the test's expectation was stale, as the review request itself flagged.

ENHANCEMENT (forward-compat): test_iteration17_desktop.py uses a hardcoded EXPECTED_FILES set that has now needed updating in iter18 (+3) and iter19 (+2). Recommend refactoring to compute the expected set dynamically (e.g., os.walk(pkg_root) filtered by .pyc/__pycache__) so future desktop file additions don't break the test.

The live ElevenLabs smoke uses /v1/voices to discover the first available voice_id at test time, so it adapts to whatever voices the .env key has access to — if the key is rotated to one with zero voices, the test will pytest.skip rather than fail.
